title: micro-sam
description: Segment objects in a 2D microscopy image or 3D Z-stack from point and box prompts with Segment Anything for Microscopy (vit_t_lm or vit_t_em_organelles).

segment.title: Segment from prompts
segment.description: Compute micro-sam slice embeddings, segment one object per prompt (with optional 3D Z-stack propagation) and return the label TIFF and per-object CSV table.

image.description: One 2D TIFF, OME-TIFF, PNG image or 3D OME-TIFF/ImageJ Z-stack

prompts.description: JSON array, one entry per object: {"points": [[x, y, 1 or 0], ...], "box": [x0, y0, x1, y1] or null, "slice"?: 0, "propagate"?: false}, in pixels from the top-left; 1 is a positive and 0 a negative point

model.description: micro-sam generalist model: vit_t_lm for light microscopy or vit_t_em_organelles for electron microscopy organelles

channel.description: Channel or page the model sees, counting from 1; 0 uses colour (RGB) when the image has it, else the first channel

iouThreshold.description: Adjacent-slice IoU threshold below which 3D Z-stack propagation stops

boxExtension.description: Relative margin added to the projected bounding box during 3D Z-stack propagation

backend.description: Encoder backend; auto prefers WebGPU and falls back to WebAssembly
